title: A $200 Balloon Flies Higher Than Any Airplane On Earth
description: AI-narrated commentary on how an ordinary weather balloon can climb higher than any commercial jet ever flies, using nothing but helium and a couple hundred dollars of gear. #space #shorts #science

hook_candidates.text: A guy in his backyard let go of one balloon — it flew higher than any airplane ever will.
A party balloon filled with helium can float higher than any commercial airplane will ever fly.
What altitude do you actually need to see the curve of the Earth — and could a balloon get you there?
You don't need a rocket or a billion dollars to reach near space — about $200 and a latex balloon will do it.
